question: What request rate applies to a Serper account that holds only the 2,500 free queries?
why: The home page gives 50, 100, 200 and 300 queries per second for the four paid packs and a default of 300 for the Ultimate credits in its FAQ, and no rate for the free queries; the account pages (dashboard, playground, billing) sit behind a sign-in. Third-party notes disagree and cite no Serper page: 5 requests per second on the free tier (skillhub.360.com), around 100 requests per second (jan.net.cn, vectle.com), and a CSDN article that calls the free limit unpublished. Only a keyed burst from an account that holds free credits alone would measure it, which needs a sign-up.
